facts.text: Bemelmans Bar has murals by Ludwig Bemelmans.
facts.excerpt: An iconic New York hideaway, renowned for nightly piano, late-night jazz and murals by Ludwig Bemelmans.

facts.text: Ludwig Bemelmans was commissioned in 1947 to paint murals in the bar depicting all four seasons in Central Park.

facts.text: Cafe Carlyle is a supper club set against Marcel Vertes' murals, with classic cabaret.

facts.text: Cafe Carlyle originally opened in 1955.
